items.name: Roslene Pruitt
items.text: Perfect job detailing and ceramic coating my Tesla. He came out to the house and spent the day making my car look brand new. The ceramic coating on the seats is top notch. So happy with the job that was done!

items.name: taw pruitt
items.text: 5 FULL STARS! I've never been more impressed with how clean and shiny my vehicle has been inside and out! Landon is spectacular to deal with. He texted reminders about our appointment leading up to our appointment. Then he messaged the morning of the appointment with an ETA. He showed up a little early, which was perfect, and helped me clean out a space for him to work. NOBODY does that! This company is special! I highly recommend them!

items.text: I'm amazed of this kid that's a Senior in high school and does an excellent job at detailing!! Thank you so much for coming by and detailing my husbands truck. He's very OCD! And you did an excellent job!! I recommend Shelton Premium Detail for your vehicle to look brand spanking new!!
